say:2:1341106001:1.text: The undead here are actually warriors created to subdue the Hypogeans—who'd have known?

say:3:1341106002:1.text: Even the undead themselves have forgotten about their past. But thankfully, you've uncovered their story and cleared their names... They are the true heroes.
say:3:1341106002:1.source_cn: 两千年过去，连活死人自己都将他们的过去遗忘了。但还好，...

say:4:1341106003:1.text: Mr. Faramor, do you still think the existence of Graveborn goes against the natural order?
say:4:1341106003:1.source_cn: 那么，法拉莫尔先生还是觉得亡灵的存在有悖于自然秩序吗？

say:5:1341106004:1.text: There's no clear answer... Maybe the Graveborn are meant to dwell in the shadows, and both light and shadow belong to nature.
say:5:1341106004:1.source_cn: 谁知道呢……也许亡灵天生就藏在自然秩序的阴影中。而光与...

say:6:1341106005:1.text: Don't assume they're evil just because they exist in the shadows.

choice_prompt:7:1341106005.text: Don't assume they're evil just because they exist in the shadows.

say:8:1341106006:1.text: I know what you're getting at, and my answer is... yes. I'll keep on taking down the vile Graveborn for the people's safety.
say:8:1341106006:1.source_cn: 我知道你们想问什么，我的答案是……会。我会继续做亡灵猎...

say:9:1341106007:1.text: Still, I'd really love to meet some harmless Graveborn. Maybe one day, I'll even have a few Graveborn close friends!
say:9:1341106007:1.source_cn: 但我也想认识一些不一样的亡灵。或许有一天，我会和几位亡...

say:10:1341106008:1.text: Haha, I look forward to knowing them better.
say:10:1341106008:1.source_cn: 哈哈，希望我有更多的机会了解他们。

say:11:1341106009:1.text: Mr. Faramor, what's your next move?
say:11:1341106009:1.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，你接下来有什么打算？

say:12:1341106010:1.text: I'll depart after a short break. Since the festival's over, it's time for me to continue hunting down those who corrupted my hometown.
say:12:1341106010:1.source_cn: 再休整一段时间，我就要离开白山了。祭典已经结束，我也该...

say:13:1341106011:1.text: I heard you'll be setting off soon as well. May the gods keep you safe during your journey, and I hope our paths will cross again.
say:13:1341106011:1.source_cn: 诸位，我听说你们也将要启程，愿众神保佑你们平安，希望你...

say:14:1341106012:1.text: Thanks, Mr. Faramor! I believe we'll meet again!
say:14:1341106012:1.source_cn: 嗯！谢谢你，法拉莫尔先生！我们——会再见的！
